meta.name: saga-orchestration
meta.description: Implement saga patterns for distributed transactions and cross-aggregate workflows. Use this skill when implementing distributed transactions across microservices where 2PC is unavailable, designing compensating actions for failed order workflows that span inventory, payment, and shipping services, building event-driven saga coordinators for travel booking systems that must roll back hotel, flight, and car rental reservations atomically, or debugging stuck saga states in production where compensation steps never complete.

copy.tagline: 让跨系统操作在失败时自动撤销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的操作牵动多个系统,一步失败就要全部回退。
copy.tagline_en: Roll back failed steps across multiple systems to keep data consistent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your operation spans multiple systems and needs full rollback when any part fails

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把跨多个服务的分布式事务设计成 saga 模式：生成有序步骤、失败时的补偿回滚、超时配置，并给出监控和恢复卡住任务的方法。
howto.when: 当你要在微服务间实现分布式事务、设计失败补偿操作，或排查补偿步骤卡住的问题时，Claude 会启用这个技能。

say.text: 帮我设计一个订单支付的 saga，包含库存回滚。
say.note: 生成带补偿步骤的 saga 定义和实现。

say.text: 我的 saga 卡在补偿状态，如何排查？
say.note: 给出卡住原因和 DLQ 恢复建议。

say.text: 为旅行预订系统写一个 saga 协调器，回滚酒店和航班。
say.note: 生成协调器代码和监控配置。

howto.what_en: Claude designs sagas for distributed transactions: ordered steps, compensating rollbacks, timeout settings, and monitoring/recovery for stuck states.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're implementing distributed transactions across microservices, designing compensation actions, or debugging stuck saga compensation states.

say_en.text: Design a saga for my order payment with inventory rollback.
say_en.note: Generates saga definition with compensating steps.

say_en.text: My saga is stuck in compensation, how do I debug it?
say_en.note: Provides diagnosis and DLQ recovery advice.

say_en.text: Write a saga coordinator for a travel booking system to roll back hotel and flight.
say_en.note: Generates coordinator code and monitoring setup.
